issues.description: DIRECT_MONOTONIC_BLOCK_SHIFT duplicated rather than referenced from canonical source
issues.detail: The constant was previously imported from Lucene99FlatVectorsFormat; the move introduces a new copy in Lucene99ScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat with value 16. If the canonical value ever changes, two sources of truth will silently disagree. Either re-export from the original or add a literate comment stating it must match the on-disk format.

issues.description: Service-loader exposes write-disabled formats with no readable termination story
issues.detail: Both legacy formats are registered as KnnVectorsFormat services but fieldsWriter throws UnsupportedOperationException. A user who selects them by name at write time gets a runtime failure rather than a compile-time or validation-time signal. The invariant 'these are read-only' deserves an explicit comment at the service-file and on the class, not just an exception message.

issues.description: Dropped numMergeWorkers/mergeExec parameters silently ignored in deprecated constructors
issues.detail: The legacy constructor still accepts numMergeWorkers and mergeExec but no longer stores them. A reader of this code cannot tell from the signature that those arguments are now dead. A one-line literate comment ('accepted for ABI compatibility; ignored because writes are disabled') would make the invariant obvious.

issues.description: Visibility downgrade from protected to package-private breaks subclass invariant without note
issues.detail: OffHeapQuantizedByteVectorValues fields changed from protected to package-private. Existing extenders outside the package (this is a public abstract class) lose access. The class is still public; either restore protected, seal the class, or document that no extension is supported now that it lives in backward_codecs.

issues.description: Test-only RW format hardcodes default maxConn/beamWidth/numMergeWorkers, ignoring constructor args
issues.detail: Lucene99RWV1HnswScalarQuantizationVectorsFormat.fieldsWriter passes DEFAULT_MAX_CONN, DEFAULT_BEAM_WIDTH, and 1 merge worker even when the constructor received different values. Tests that vary these parameters will silently exercise defaults instead. State the invariant in a comment or thread the fields through.

issues.description: Reader/Writer classes lack a literate comment explaining the on-disk format invariant they now solely preserve
issues.detail: Once these formats are quarantined as read-only legacy, their job is to faithfully decode bytes written by older Lucene versions. The classes carry no top-level note describing which versions wrote each format variant and what bit-layout invariant the reader maintains. A short literate comment per class would serve future archaeologists.

review.summary: UNDER-AUDITED. The refactor is mostly a mechanical package move plus a write-disabling change, which is the correct shape. The algorithmic content (quantization, HNSW, off-heap reads) is untouched, so complexity and invariants are preserved by transport. What's missing is the literate-comment layer that should accompany a quarantine: the read-only invariant, the version provenance of each on-disk format, and the now-dead constructor parameters all warrant explicit notes. The duplicated DIRECT_MONOTONIC_BLOCK_SHIFT constant is the one concrete correctness risk; the visibility downgrade and registered-but-throwing service entries are smaller readability and contract issues.
